review_method: 官方 .edu 页面逐一访问核实(专业存在+系页可回跳);联系方式仅收机构级公开信息

universities.name: Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT)
universities.program: School of Photographic Arts and Sciences
universities.degrees: BFA Photographic and Imaging Arts (广告/艺术/摄影记者方向), BS Photographic Sciences, MFA Photography and Related Media, Photography Minor
universities.notes: 美国摄影教育旗舰、全美规模最大的摄影院系之一,兼有影像科学专业,学生器材密度和技术敏感度极高,是镜头品牌校园活动的头号目标。

universities.name: Syracuse University
universities.program: S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications — Visual Communications / Multimedia, Photography and Design
universities.degrees: Bachelor's (Photography/Visual Communications), MS Multimedia Photography and Design
universities.notes: Newhouse 是新闻传播名门,摄影记者/视觉叙事方向学生大量外拍新闻纪实题材,对轻量定焦和长焦镜头需求天然强。

universities.name: School of Visual Arts (SVA)
universities.program: BFA Photography and Video

universities.notes: 曼哈顿市中心的摄影名校,BFA 把照片与视频合一培养,商业+艺术摄影学生密集,活动可辐射纽约摄影圈。

universities.name: Parsons School of Design (The New School)
universities.program: Photography BFA
universities.notes: 纽约顶级设计学院,时尚/艺术摄影方向,校区毗邻切尔西画廊区与时尚产业,品牌曝光溢出效应好。

universities.name: Pratt Institute
universities.program: School of Art — Photography
universities.notes: 布鲁克林艺术名校,BFA 毕业展直接进纽约画廊,胶片+数字并重的课程意味着学生持续采购镜头与转接方案。

universities.name: New York University (Tisch)
universities.program: Tisch School of the Arts — Department of Photography and Imaging (DPI)
universities.notes: 纽约市中心综合名校的独立摄影系,覆盖模拟/数字/多媒体全模式影像,学生背景多元、社媒影响力强。

universities.name: Fashion Institute of Technology (FIT, SUNY)
universities.program: Photography and Related Media
universities.notes: 曼哈顿公立设计院校,时尚/棚拍/商业摄影方向,学费低学生量大,人像定焦类产品的精准受众。

universities.name: Purchase College, SUNY
universities.program: School of Art+Design — Photography
universities.notes: 纽约都会圈的公立艺术强校,BFA 摄影项目排名口碑好,距曼哈顿约30英里,活动成本低且学生实拍活跃。

universities.name: Rhode Island School of Design (RISD)
universities.program: Photography Department
universities.notes: 全美顶级艺术学院,摄影系 BFA/MFA 声誉极高,与布朗大学同城可联动,活动背书价值大。

universities.name: Massachusetts College of Art and Design (MassArt)
universities.program: Photography Department
universities.notes: 全美唯一独立公立艺术院校,地处波士顿艺术区,BFA/MFA/PostBac 梯队完整且有常设摄影讲座系列可挂靠活动。

universities.name: Temple University (Tyler School of Art and Architecture)
universities.program: Tyler School of Art and Architecture — Photography
universities.notes: 费城综合大学旗下的名艺术学院,课程从古典工艺到前沿数字并重,城市校园交通便利、学生基数大。

universities.name: Penn State University
universities.program: School of Visual Arts (College of Arts & Architecture)
universities.degrees: B.Des. Professional Photography, BFA/BA Art (摄影方向), Photography Minor
universities.notes: 少见的职业摄影 B.Des 学位加艺术摄影双轨,巨型综合校园人流量大,品牌触达面远超纯艺术院校。

universities.name: Drexel University (Westphal College)

universities.name: Maryland Institute College of Art (MICA)
universities.program: Photography (Major)
universities.degrees: BFA (另有 MFA Photography + Media & Society)
universities.notes: 百年历史的摄影项目(全球最早之一),棚拍/暗房/打印设施完善,巴尔的摩艺术区地标院校。

universities.name: George Washington University (Corcoran School)

universities.name: University of Hartford (Hartford Art School)

universities.name: Rutgers University (Mason Gross School of the Arts)

universities.name: Maine College of Art & Design (MECA&D)
universities.program: BFA in Photography

universities.name: Savannah College of Art and Design (SCAD)

universities.name: Virginia Commonwealth University (VCUarts)
universities.program: Department of Photography and Film, VCUarts
universities.notes: 全美顶级公立艺术学院,独立的摄影与电影系,学生兼跨照片与视频创作,与摄影/电影镜头产品线双重契合。

universities.name: Western Kentucky University
